official.description: The Faculty of Science of the University of Geneva, with the support of external partners, has established an Excellence Fellowship programme open to outstanding and highly motivated students who wish to pursue a Master of Science degree in one of the disciplines covered by the Faculty. official.program_type: Faculty-level excellence grant scheme for incoming Master of Science students
official.english_requirement: The fellowship page mandates no separate English test; TOEFL or other language test results are listed only as optional 'other pertinent information'. Master's programmes are either entirely in English or in English and French.

applicant_utility.summary: This is an excellence-selected cash grant of CHF 10,000-15,000 per year for students entering any MSc in the UNIGE Faculty of Science, with no teaching duties and automatic renewal across the full 3-4 semester programme provided you pass your first semester. Its unusual mechanic is that the fellowship sits downstream of admission: you must already have begun the UNIGE enrolment for your chosen MSc before your file is even considered. The window is narrow and fixed each year - it opens at the beginning of January and closes on 28 February - so treat your MSc registration, not the fellowship form, as the action item that starts the clock.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Bachelor graduates ranked among the best of their cohort who want a research-oriented MSc in Geneva without teaching obligations.
application_readiness_checklist: Begin the UNIGE enrolment for your chosen MSc early - you need the 'UNIGE-Candidature: Depot de votre dossier' confirmation e-mail (or your UNIGE card) inside the fellowship file
Watch for the personal application link e-mailed after registration once the January window opens; there is no public form to find
Assemble every item into ONE pdf in English or French - the Faculty rejects files that are not single-pdf or are incomplete
Brief your two referees on the specific MSc you have chosen, since the letters must attest aptitude to that programme
Order a full transcript with all bachelor's grades (not a summary) and keep the CV to 2 pages
common_rejection_risks: Missing proof of UNIGE enrolment registration - without the card scan or the candidature e-mail the file is not considered, whatever the grades
Submitting several PDFs or an over-length CV, or leaving one listed document out; all clauses must be completed
Applying after having already started a Master at the Faculty of Science, which is a hard exclusion
Not meeting the admission criteria of the chosen MSc - the fellowship selection is made on the basis of the application file against those criteria
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The award is a cash grant only; tuition, housing, Swiss health insurance, residence-permit costs and travel are not covered by the published terms, and Geneva is a high-cost city, so most fellows will need substantial additional funds.
document_audit: Reference letters must come from two professors - employers or assistants do not match the published requirement
The transcript must cover the full bachelor's education with all grades, not just the final year
Proof of registration differs by status: current UNIGE students upload a card scan, everyone else uploads the 'UNIGE-Candidature: Depôt de votre dossier' e-mail
GRE/TOEFL results are optional but are explicitly welcomed as 'other pertinent information' - include them if you have strong scores
alerts: The 28 February deadline applies to the intake starting the following 14 September; there is no rolling submission and the form link only exists during the January-February window
The grant can be lost at renewal if the first semester is not academically successful - year one is effectively a probationary performance review
Some awards are financed by external partners (a Geneva private foundation, the Werner Foundation), so awards within the CHF 10,000-15,000 band may not be uniform across the cohort
The published page can lag behind the calendar - as of 10 October 2026 it still advertises the concluded 28 February 2026 round, so check the winners/updates page in January for the next call
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register for the MSc (enrolment) -> receive the personal application link by e-mail in January -> complete the online form -> upload one combined PDF by 28 February.
